source claimMeasure PL from 80 to 430 K. Fit spectra with Lorentzian functions and extract PL peak energy, FWHM and intensity. The observed trend changes are assigned to γ-tetragonal-1 → β-tetragonal-2 at 140 K and β → α-cubic at 250 K. These are source interpretations supported by optical/Raman trends, not variable-temperature coordinate refinements on the QDs. · Claim class: reported_measurement_and_interpretation. G3: Factor-series panels have specified conditions but no complete replicate or exact cross-technique physical-batch map. Final dispersions have unreported concentration/storage. No isolated yield, absolute PLQY or measured solar-cell efficiency is supplied. G4: No measured QD CIF/coordinates, occupancy refinement, SAED dataset or exact training pair. Source/cited phase cells and conceptual drawings are separate from QD measurements; no surface ligand/particle geometry is inferred. G5: Measurement physical form/atmosphere/mounting, thermal dwell/ramp, laser power, XRD settings, TEM preparation/counts and full fit coefficients/errors are missing. Curves are not digitized or refitted.reportedSource evidencetemperature-dependent PLfact-context-pl-temperature-scansasongko2025 · MAIN PDF p. 4 (printed 15345), Figures 4 and 5; Results; original SHA256 3ce868c1778f11e0d703e2bf68c47dfa6537f0a70716372977251caeb0b3efc6; sasongko2025 · MAIN PDF p. 5 (printed 15346), Figures 4 and 5; original SHA256 3ce868c1778f11e0d703e2bf68c47dfa6537f0a70716372977251caeb0b3efc6; sasongko2025 · SI PDF p. 4 (printed S4), Analysis and Characterization; original SHA256 d0e6fc7676c629e3f4a621b53495fb43716985d3018d60e99de192e2788ae38e
